name: NightCafe Studio
tagline: NightCafe Studio is one of the longest-running AI art platforms, offering access to multiple generation models — Stable Diffusion, DALL-E, and proprietary models — through a credit-based web interface. Its built-in community allows creators to share, comment, and collaborate on AI art, and daily challenges keep the community engaged. It's a popular starting point for people exploring AI art who want variety and a supportive community without technical setup.
